title: Millionaire for Life Number Watch — Number 48 Has Gone Quiet for 50+ Draws
headline: Number 48 Has Gone Quiet for 50+ Draws

prose.intro: The Millionaire for Life board has a new record holder for silence. Number 48 has gone 50+ straight drawings without an appearance.
prose.fact: Before this run, no gap in the 50-draw sample had stretched beyond 37 drawings. Number 48 just moved the ceiling to 50+.
prose.context: Worth saying plainly: none of this makes anything "due". Every drawing starts from scratch, and no gap or pattern carries over. This entry documents an extreme in the dataset — that's all it is.
